name: Delta Galil Industries Ltd.
summary: Delta Galil Industries Ltd. engages in the design, development, production, marketing, and sale of intimate and activewear products in Israel, the United States, Europe, Germany, and internationally. It sells intimate apparel and loungewear products under the Delta, Fix, Panta Rei, Disney, and Victoria's Secret brand through retail stores, e-commerce sites, and wholesale points of sale to mid-tier retailers. The company also sells denim under the 7 For All Mankind through retail stores, wholesale channels, and the brand DTC website; operates Organic Basics, a digital apparel brand; and Bare Necessities, a online retailer of intimate apparel and swimwear.
